title: Underpayment Variance Standard for Internal Appeals — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Variance standard, Insurance Coverage & Claims.** When Halverson Clinical Laboratories files an internal appeal with a contracted commercial plan, an underpayment addition reflects how far the claim was allowed below the coverage's own twelve-month experience.

## Terms

- **Allowed ratio.** The plan's payment plus the member responsibility assigned, divided by that payment plus the contractual adjustment plus that member responsibility. The *claim's own allowed ratio* takes these amounts over the claim's lines; the *coverage's twelve-month allowed ratio* takes them over every such line on the coverage within the last twelve months.
- **Underpayment gap.** Figured only where the claim has a paid line: the coverage's twelve-month allowed ratio less the claim's own allowed ratio, in percentage points. Where the claim has no paid line there is no gap.
- **Paid-line charges.** The plan's payment plus the contractual adjustment plus the member responsibility on the claim.

## Standard

| Underpayment gap | Underpayment addition |
|---|---|
| Exceeds 5 percentage points (the variance tolerance) | The whole gap applied to the paid-line charges: the gap divided by one hundred, times the paid-line charges |
| Exceeds 2 percentage points (the variance floor) but not 5 | Only the part of the gap above 2 points applied: the gap less 2, divided by one hundred, times the paid-line charges |
| 2 percentage points or less, or no gap | Nothing |

## Worked questions (hypothetical figures, paid-line charges 800.00 USD)

- *Twelve-month ratio 0.78, claim's own ratio 0.70.* The gap is 8 points, which exceeds 5: 8 divided by one hundred, times 800.00, an addition of 64.00 USD.
- *Twelve-month ratio 0.74, claim's own ratio 0.70.* The gap is 4 points, above 2 but not above 5: 4 less 2 is 2, divided by one hundred, times 800.00, an addition of 16.00 USD.
- *Gap of exactly 5 points.* It does not exceed 5, so only the part above 2 counts: 3 divided by one hundred, times 800.00, 24.00 USD.
- *Gap of exactly 2 points, or a negative gap.* Nothing is added.
